description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based medical exam questions with comprehensive instructions, explanations, and references for use in medical education MCQs.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based medical multiple-choice questions based on difficulty, content, and context.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality, accuracy, and appropriateness of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring criteria.
